topic: audio mixer and mobile skill menu responsiveness
currentUserGoal: Separate background music from sound effects, make the grass touch crunch louder, add options sliders for both layers, and reduce mobile lag while navigating/upgrading through the skill menu.
changesMade: Added persisted SFX volume settings alongside music volume settings.
Fixed a storage default bug where missing localStorage values were read as 0 instead of the intended defaults.
Changed default music volume to 62% and default SFX volume to 100%.
Raised SFX headroom and grass touch transient gain so touch crunch is more audible on phones.
Split the in-game Options panel into Music volume and SFX volume sliders, with an SFX preview tick on slider touch.
Reduced skill menu drag work by throttling minimap redraws during map panning and doing a final minimap update on release.
Reduced redundant skill purchase work by removing duplicate full layout/UI refreshes from the low-level upgrade helper.
Added a cached upgrade lookup map for hot skill-tree visibility, detail, and connection redraw paths.
verification: Browser perf harness at 390x844, ?perfHarness&tiles=1200 before skill optimization: skillOpen had ui:skillTree around 0.4ms and no frame spikes.
Browser perf harness at 390x844, ?perfHarness&tiles=1200 after skill optimization: no frame spikes, skillOpen remained around ui:skillTree 0.4ms, skillSelect showed no skill-tree hotspot.
Mobile visual smoke at 390x844: Options panel displays Music volume 62% and SFX volume 100% on a fresh profile.
Mobile interaction smoke: tapping the SFX slider writes grassTouching.sfxVolume independently of music volume.
Mobile visual smoke: Skill screen opens at 390x844 and map drag leaves the minimap stable.
currentGitStatus: Modified hotfix files are expected before commit.

Unrelated untracked docs/assets remain untouched: docs/GAME_SYSTEMS_REFERENCE CLAUDE.md, Dutch automation docs, docs/artifacts/title-art-2026-06-19/, docs/grasstouching.mid, docs/lucid.aif, handoffs/HANDOFF_2026-06-20_POST_PUSH_WORKFLOW_TEST.json.
knownIssues: Actual iOS audio loudness still needs user/device confirmation because Windows cannot audibly verify Safari speaker output.
Perf harness does not simulate repeated real skill purchases; the code path was optimized by reducing redundant refresh/layout calls and mobile drag graphics redraws.
nextRecommendedSteps: Deploy production and have the user hard refresh on iPhone.
On iOS, test Options sliders: set Music around 40-60% and SFX 100%, then tap grass repeatedly.
In the skill menu, drag around and buy several affordable skills quickly to validate the reduced sticky feeling on device.
doNotRevert: Do not restore the old audio storage reader behavior; missing storage must use defaults, not 0.
Do not reintroduce full layoutSkillTree plus multiple refreshUi calls from buyUpgrade; skill purchase UI updates should stay owned by the click handler.
Do not redraw the skill minimap on every pointermove while dragging.
